11 ارباكّ رَأْيُهُ عَلَيْهِ , (K, * TA,) inf. n. اِرْبِيكَاكٌ, (TA,) (assumed tropical:) His opinion, or judgment, was, or became, confused to him. (Ibn-'Abbád, K, TA.) ―
-b2- And ارباكّ عَنِ الأَمْرِ (assumed tropical:) He (a man) paused, or stopped, from the affair. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
